name: Kaga
source: An elementalist with a great affinity and attunement towards nature, Kaga seeks to calm the land of the magical mystery. He is contemplative, often thinking of the ways of the world, though sometimes the customs of his people may lead him to do things that might take others by surprise. In battle, he can fight close or far away by summoning elementals to aid the party in a myriad of ways.
